It also uses `gridProps: { md, xs }`, which the `page:home` defaultConfig schema does not accept. instruction:
Fix `plugins/notifications/src/components/UnreadNotificationsCard/UnreadNotificationsCard.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. minor: No test covers what happens when mark-as-read fails. That path (updateNotifications rejects, then toastApi.post is called with title 'Failed to mark notification as read' and status 'danger') is new error-handling code with no assertion. The plan did not ask for this test, but it is the card's only error path that has no test. — fix: In the existing mark-as-read test, or in one more case, make updateNotifications reject once. Click Mark as read and assert, using findBy or an awaited flush, that toastApi.post was called with expect.objectContaining({ title: 'Failed to mark notification as read', status: 'danger' }).
2. minor: The API mocks are cast with `as any` in every render (notifications, toast and signal APIs), and `emit` is typed `(msg: any) => void`. This turns off type checking on the fixtures. NotificationsPage.test.tsx in the same run passes the same kind of mocks without casts. — fix: Drop the `as any` casts where TestApiProvider accepts partial mocks, as NotificationsPage.test.tsx does. Type `emit` as `((msg: NotificationSignal) => void) | undefined`.
